Title: Epikasta Rigatos and Mask of a 1000-faces

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
Is there a distinction between playing an action and performing an action?

In this case, if Epikasta Rigatos plays a Kine Resources Contested and Foureyes plays Mask of a Thousand Faces to take up the action and is not performing the action instead, can I shuffle the Kine Resources Contested back to my deck after the action?

I don't see anything conclusive in the rulings for either card.

Name: Epikasta Rigatos
[KoT:PT2/B2, FB:PTo1]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 4
Capacity: 8
Discipline: cel AUS DOM PRE
Camarilla Prince of New York: You can move an action card Epikasta played from your ash heap to your library after resolution (shuffle afterward).
Artist: Becky Jollensten

Name: Mask of a Thousand Faces
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, KMW:PB2, LotN:PA, KoT:U, HttB:PSam2]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
[obf] Only usable by a ready, unlocked vampire other than the acting minion who is capable of performing the action. Not usable if any action modifiers or other effects have been used that could not have been used if this vampire were the acting vampire. Unlock the acting minion and lock this vampire instead. The action continues with this vampire as the acting minion.
[OBF] As above, with +1 stealth.
Artist: Jeff Menges; Leif Jones

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Kraus wrote:
> Is there a distinction between playing an action and performing an action?
>
You cannot "play an action". You can play an action card.

> Kraus wrote:
> In this case, if Epikasta Rigatos plays a Kine Resources Contested and Foureyes plays Mask of a Thousand Faces to take up the action and is not performing the action instead, can I shuffle the Kine Resources Contested back to my deck after the action?
>
Yes, the card was played by Epikasta in the first place. The best analogy I could find is the same action modifier can be played twice, the first time by the original vampire, then by the masking vampire; because they are played by different vampires.
